description: Source code for managing logical channels, slices, and buffer statuses in a scheduler, including classes and functions for handling UE logical channels, QoS tracking, buffer updates, and transport block building.

classes.name: logical_channel_mapper
classes.description: Manages mapping of logical channels and logical channel groups, QoS tracking, and buffer status updates.

classes.name: logical_channel_system
classes.description: Main system managing UE logical channels, slices, and buffer statuses, including UE creation and removal.

classes.name: ue_logical_channel_repository
classes.description: Repository for managing logical channels of a specific UE, including buffer status, slice assignment, and MAC SDU allocation.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates QoS and buffer status metrics at each slot indication.

methods.name: create_ue
methods.description: Creates a new UE entry with specified configuration and returns a repository handle.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE and all associated logical channels and slices.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures logical channels for a UE based on provided configuration list.

methods.name: set_lcid_ran_slice
methods.description: Assigns a logical channel to a specific RAN slice.

methods.name: set_lcg_ran_slice
methods.description: Assigns a logical channel group to a specific RAN slice.

methods.name: deregister_lc_ran_slice
methods.description: Removes a logical channel from its RAN slice.

methods.name: deregister_lcg_ran_slice
methods.description: Removes a logical channel group from its RAN slice.

methods.name: handle_dl_buffer_status_indication
methods.description: Handles buffer status updates for a logical channel.

methods.name: handle_mac_ce_indication
methods.description: Processes MAC Control Element indications for a UE.

methods.name: handle_bsr_indication
methods.description: Processes Buffer Status Reports for a UE.

methods.name: handle_sr_indication
methods.description: Marks a UE as having pending scheduling request.

methods.name: allocate_mac_sdu
methods.description: Allocates space for a MAC SDU in a logical channel.

methods.name: allocate_mac_ce
methods.description: Allocates space for a MAC Control Element.

methods.name: allocate_ue_con_res_id_mac_ce
methods.description: Allocates space for UE Connection Release indication MAC CE.

methods.name: build_dl_fallback_transport_block_info
methods.description: Builds transport block info with fallback data, including CEs and SDUs.

methods.name: build_dl_transport_block_info
methods.description: Builds transport block info with specified slices, including CEs and SDUs.
